author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using Crown Tools’ Paragon blade to cut this porcelain. I’m impressed with this blade because it doesn’t chip and won’t overheat. Of course each blade performs slightly different based on the tile, so that’s why I tested it. But this combined with the electroplated polishing pad for minor adjustments was a great duo #tiletools #tileshower #bathroomremodel #howto
title: Make Perfect Cuts in Porcelain Tile - #tiletools #porcelaintile #showertile
